metrics.transcript: Okay, everyone, settle in.  We are picking up where we left off last week.  The party is standing at the gates of Karakdon, and the dwarven sentries are not happy to  see you.  Borin's Donnebird steps forward and demands to know why a half-orc barbarian is carrying  the royal seal.  Grok, what do you do?  Grok says he found it on a dead courier near the river, and he wants a reward.  Roll me a persuasion check.  Thirteen?  With your bonus that is a fifteen, Borin narrows his ice but lets you through, inside the  hall.  Aldrich the Paladin notices the torches are burning green, which he has only seen once  before.  During the siege of Donbreaker, Vera, our Elven Ranger, wants to check the shadows near  the throne.  Give me a perception roll.  Natural twenty.  You spot a cloak figure slipping behind a pillar, clutching a black dagger with runes  that glow faintly.  The figure whispers something in an old tongue, and the green flames flare up all around  you.  Roll initiative.  Everybody.  Aldrich goes first with the nineteen.  And Vera, then the cloak stranger, then Grok, Aldrich, the stranger is thirty feet  away across the cracked marble floor.  What is your move?
